BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, gibbêach means to be high, bald (in the forehead), having a bald forehead. It occurs just once, in Leviticus.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: gibbêach means to be high, bald (in the forehead), having a bald forehead, and I do not stretch it further.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
